Engage our virtual store adepts with solid industry backgrounds. They’ll help you manage orders, optimize your inventory storage, and ensure fast product delivery.

Integration, Migration, and Maintenance and Support Services

Integration of Third-Party Extensions

Our engineers will enhance your virtual store with engaging shopping experiences. Be it a dropshipping app or embedded apps’ UIs in your admin dashboard, they’ll help you grow conversions.

ERP/CRM Integration

Our certified engineers will leverage Shopify’s Global ERP program to integrate your store with top ERP providers. They also can connect with the most popular CRMs like Salesforce or Hubspot.

Migration to the Shopify Platform

Mobilunity will find qualified specialists to transfer your current virtual store to Shopify. They’ll create URL redirects and migrate your store assets, ensuring their integrity and accessibility.

Proactive Maintenance and Support

Once your Shopify app is ready, hire a Shopify expert to ensure timely updates of its components and APIs. They’ll identify and eliminate vulnerabilities and optimize your app’s performance.

With Mobilunity’s engineers, you can create virtual shops that meet your needs. Our tech adepts will help you add useful extensions to your online shopping platform. Also, they’ll test new functionalities without affecting your customized Shopify live store.

Front-End Development

Skilled engineers provided by Mobilunity will make your web store stand out. They embrace custom Shopify theme development and create elegant and feature-rich storefronts.

Using Git for Version Control

Mobilunity’s engineers use Git version control to build custom Shopify stores. It allows them to collaborate, streamline code reviews, and restore previous versions. It also improves code quality, minimizes errors, and promotes a structured development process.

Mobile-First Approach

The e-shop engineers we provide emphasize the mobile-first principle. They’ll work on the design, layout, and navigation of your mobile app to ensure delightful buying experiences.

FAQs on Contracting Shopify Engineers

How much does it cost to hire a Shopify developer?

The cost will depend on the expertise and location of your Shopify expert and your Shopify development needs. Schedule a free consultation to estimate the cost of your eCommerce website project.

Do you charge a setup fee?

No Mobilunity doesn’t apply any fees above the agreed Effective Daily Rate (EFD) or monthly fee. However, we charge moderate overheads to run your engineers’ back-office support and retention.

Will Mobilunity manage my team?

You manage the tasks and performance of your dedicated development team or FLEX devs. Meanwhile, the accounting, legal, HR, and IT are on our end.

Which technical skills are essential for a Shopify engineer?

A professional Shopify engineer must know HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and Liquid languages. This background enables them to create interactive website designs and build theme-customized stores. Expert developers should have strong API integration skills and understand SEO principles. Additionally, e-commerce engineers should demonstrate knowledge of Shopify Plus features.

How do I evaluate a Shopify web developer’s expertise?

Offer take-home tests or arrange interviews with live coding. This way, you’ll assess how well your candidate knows best practices, relevant tools, and approaches. Ask practical coding questions while discussing the assignment. Additionally, you can check your programmer’s code portfolio and GitHub activity.

Do you offer assistance with technical interviews?

Absolutely. With our technical interviews as a service, our on-demand experts will assess the candidates’ hard skills on your behalf. You’ll get reports with professional recommendations that help you select top-tier engineers.

What are the advantages of hiring top Shopify developers remotely?

You can hire Shopify web developers nearshore or offshore and cut up to 50% of costs. Also, you’ll access the global tech talent market where you can find niche specialists.

Do your engineers provide ongoing support and optimization of my online store?

Certainly. We’ll provide website development engineers if you’re looking for Shopify support and maintenance services. They’ll keep your Shopify store updated, secured, SEO-optimized, responsive, and fast-loading.

Can you build a Shopify turnkey solution?

Mobilunity isn’t a Shopify development company or a Shopify agency that delivers ready-to-use platforms. Instead, we help you contract Shopify developers to build solutions of any scope.

What other Shopify services do your Shopify developers can help with?

Mobilunity’s developers create virtual store solutions for startups and deploy Shopify apps on Docker They also integrate Content Management Systems into your e-shop, using advanced programming approaches. Additionally, you can engage our engineers for custom Shopify app development.
